title: Financial household management data of Dutch couples
descriptions: This data was gathered by the ThinkForward initiative to study the financial behavior of households in the beginning of 2017. The data panel of Motivaction Netherlands was used to find adult household members. Partners of household members were then asked to complete the same questionnaire. The data sets include the original data file of individuals in Dutch and the data file of couples constructed by matching individuals belonging to the same households.
